comment: Queued search candidates (P23b, P27R, buffix; timepack4 from the archive's rebase_inputs) and speed patches (S11-S14, S29) for the S45 rebase-readiness run. Patches are copies (sha256 below); their originals: lock archive 7_history/strength_packs (P23b, P27R, buffix, timepack4) and the opus-sol-S11/S13/S29 branches (git diff d4f4312..branch -- src include tests CMakeLists.txt).

candidates.name: P23b_RefutLmr
candidates.source: lock archive 7_history/strength_packs/p23b_refutlmr_h256/artifacts (vs the h256_e12 lock; CR_PASS_p23b)

candidates.name: P27R_QsEvasionSeeNonPv
candidates.source: lock archive 7_history/strength_packs/p27r_nonpv_h256_v2/artifacts (v2, vs the h256_e12 lock)

candidates.name: buffix

candidates.name: timepack4_TmDecisiveWinStable
candidates.source: lock archive 7_history/strength_packs/rebase_inputs/timepack4_f3_h256 (HELD rework-ready; time management only)
